schema.title: JSON schema for Entry Point Regulation manifest files

description:
Hello team,

The entry‑point policy for **https://www.example.com** has been finalized. All cached resources will be considered fresh for up to **86 400 seconds** (24 hours), and any violations will be reported to **https://www.example.com/report**. By default, navigation requests are permitted, while all other resource types are blocked unless a specific rule overrides this behavior.

Two explicit rules have been defined. The first targets the administrative section: any request whose path matches the pattern **^/admin/.*$** (e.g., “/admin/dashboard”) and that is either a navigation or a script request will be denied, with no data allowed at that endpoint. The second rule applies to the public area: any path matching **^/public/.*$** (such as “/public/images/logo.png”) will allow images, stylesheets, scripts, and XHR requests, and data transmission is permitted there. 

For reference, this configuration corresponds to metadata version **1.0**. Please review and let me know if any adjustments are needed.
